issues.title: [ui-audit] tui-app-fixture blocks on read in non-interactive harness

remediation_checklist: [ ] Catch TimeoutExpired in adapters/tui.py; record fail row not crash
[ ] Pipe stdin (\n\n) or set LI_TUI_HARNESS=1 non-interactive mode
